about: What Step 1's diagnostics must show (research/value-scale-plan.md, Step 1d). Not edited after the run: a difference is explained in the report.

D2.rule: service/pipeline/alignment.py detect_and_transform_value_scale, protein (zeros do not vote), median threshold 50
D2.right_answer: the label: linear -> detected linear; log -> detected log; foreign variants are reported, not judged

entries.pxd064083_t: linear on a small scale (median about 7) read as log, as found in amendment 1
entries.pxd064083_b: linear on a small scale (median about 8) read as log, as found in amendment 1

variants_of_linear_tables.times_1e-6: a linear table divided by a million: its median falls below 50, read as log
variants_of_linear_tables.per_protein_median: each protein divided by its median: values near 1, read as log
variants_of_linear_tables.per_cell_percent: shares of a cell's total in percent: far below 50, read as log

D2.note: D2 is the picture before the fix. Any other misread is a finding about today's rule and is listed, not a failure of the step.

D3.pipeline: v4.1, modality prot, the service's own calls (scripts/trace_workflow.py:166-189)
D3.cells: a table with more than 2,000 cells (the service's upload limit) is traced on 2,000 cells drawn with a seed from its id; a table with fewer than 20 is refused, as the service refuses it
D3.expected_refusals: the service's own validation (service/pipeline/validation.py) refuses exactly the tables with fewer than 20 cells (MIN_CELLS_REFUSE), e.g. pxd049412_hela250pg (3 runs) and pxd069060_diann_report (3 runs in the sdrf); an orientation refusal of any bank table is not expected
invariants_on_every_traced_table: when Stage 0 reads linear, the zeros it makes missing equal the zeros in the parsed table
mask sum equals the observed values in the matched genes after duplicates are merged
each z-scored gene's observed values have mean 0 and SD 1 (to 1e-4), or are all 0 for a constant gene
the encoder input (smoothed values and mask) is finite
smoothing recomputed from the graph equals the service's smoothed values (atol 1e-6)
every cell has a label or an abstention reason
